app.title: RepairCenter
app.subtitle: Repair, diagnose and maintain Windows
mode.quick.name: Quick
mode.quick.desc: SFC plus a short integrity check only. A few minutes.
mode.diagnose.name: Diagnose
mode.diagnose.desc: Read-only: CheckHealth, ScanHealth, sfc /verifyonly, chkdsk /scan. Changes nothing.
mode.repair.name: Repair
mode.repair.desc: Recommended. Repairs only what is needed and verifies the result afterwards.
mode.full.name: Full
mode.full.desc: Everything: deep scan, forced repair, disk and file system check.
opt.none.name: None
opt.safe.name: Safe
opt.safe.desc: Temporary files, DNS cache, WinSxS and fragmentation analysis. Nothing is lost.
opt.standard.name: Standard
opt.standard.desc: Adds WinSxS clean-up, update cache, error reports, TRIM or defragmentation.
opt.aggressive.name: Aggressive
opt.aggressive.desc: Adds /ResetBase, recycle bin, Windows Update component and network reset.
opt.aggressive.warn: Caution: after /ResetBase installed Windows updates can no longer be uninstalled individually. The recycle bin is emptied and the network stack is reset – a restart is required afterwards. A restore point is created automatically beforehand.
progress.title: Progress
system.title: System overview
history.title: History
about.intro: RepairCenter turns the built-in Windows tools DISM, SFC and chkdsk into one traceable workflow: first find out what is actually needed, then do only that, verify the result and document it properly. A graded maintenance stage tidies up afterwards.
about.what1: Repairs the component store and system files – with an automatic second pass when SFC could not repair everything.
about.what2: Evaluates the result from the CBS log file instead of relying on unreliable exit codes.
about.what3: Graded maintenance: temporary files, WinSxS, update cache, TRIM or defragmentation, network.
about.what4: Every run produces a report, JSON data and a tool log under C:\RepairLogs.
about.notTitle: What it deliberately does not do
about.not1: No registry cleaners, no "RAM optimisers", no tuning tweaks.
about.not2: It never disables services or startup entries on its own – they are only reported.
about.not3: No cloud, no telemetry, no network connection.

restart.title: Restart required

confirm.aggressive: Really run aggressive maintenance? Some steps cannot be undone.
report.title: Report
report.none: This file does not exist for that run.
schedule.title: Weekly maintenance
schedule.intro: Creates a task in the Windows task scheduler that runs as SYSTEM and never asks questions.
schedule.exists: A weekly maintenance task is set up.
schedule.missing: No maintenance task is set up.
schedule.unsupported: Task scheduling is available on Windows only.
config.title: Storage & service
disks.warnTitle: Caution: these functions destroy data permanently.
disks.warnText: The system disk is always refused. Every operation requires an explicit confirmation.
disks.label: Label
disks.fullFormat: Full format (overwrite instead of just clearing the directory)
disks.confirmDialog: This operation destroys data permanently. Really run it?
disks.convertLossless: This conversion is lossless via convert.exe – your data is kept.
disks.convertLossy: This change is only possible by reformatting. All data on the volume will be lost.
rescue.enable: Back up data first (erase only afterwards)
rescue.tooSmall: Not enough space on the target
analysis.title: Disk analysis
analysis.intro: Windows almost always reports “Healthy” – which only means the drive still answers. This analysis reads the raw SMART values, counts the relevant entries in the event log and reads samples across the whole surface.
analysis.skipSurface: Skip surface test (SMART and events only)
files.title: Find damaged files
files.intro: Three kinds of damage are checked: files that can no longer be read (bad sectors), files with a broken structure (a JPEG without its end marker, an archive without its directory) and empty files that should contain something.
files.stratAuto: Automatic (system files via SFC, otherwise previous version)
files.deep: Read every file completely (finds bad sectors, takes considerably longer)
files.confirmRepair: Repair the files found? Damaged versions are kept alongside.
update.title: Update
update.intro: RepairCenter never downloads anything. It checks a folder – removable media, network share or downloads – for packages named RepairCenter-X.Y.Z.zip.
readiness.title: Readiness for live operation
readiness.intro: Checks which measurement sources this machine actually provides. SMART is often unreachable through USB enclosures and RAID controllers – better to know beforehand than to wonder afterwards.
readiness.notReady: Some things are missing – see below. The analysis still runs, just with fewer sources.
update.confirmApply: Install the update now? The service shuts down briefly and restarts. A backup of the current version is created.
mode.liveHint: Real values are read and real changes are made.
mode.demoHint: Nothing is changed on the system. Start without -Demo for real measurements.
pack.title: Back up, compress and transfer
pack.intro: Move data to another drive – raw or packed. Copying uses robocopy with several threads and unbuffered I/O, so it runs at the speed the drive allows. Progress is shown live.
pack.needBoth: Please provide a source folder and a target.
files.repairHint: Scan first – then the findings can be repaired.
